intuition: KMP remembers how much of the needle already matches when a text character causes a mismatch.

brute_force.approach: Try matching the needle at every possible starting index in the haystack.

optimal.approach: Build the needle's longest-prefix-suffix table and use it to skip redundant comparisons during the scan.

edge_cases: An empty needle matches at index zero.
A needle longer than the haystack cannot match.
A partial overlap in the needle must be reused after a mismatch.
